title: One oracle tick, every 3 seconds
caption: Each live market gets a spot price and a mark price. Bad data never moves a price; it freezes it, and a long freeze halts the market.
boxes: Every Solana pool for the coin, from DexScreener
Pools weighted by liquidity, so one thin pool can't set the price
Do pools with ≥ 10% of liquidity agree within 15%?
×1M bundle for tiny prices, EMA for the mark
oraclePx, markPx and externalPerpPx for every asset in one action
Keep the last price, send an alert
Mark moves at most 1% per update; prices stay within 10x of the day's open
foot: The GRAD index is priced the same way: every component goes through the source check, then the chained index level is computed.
